guarantees.claim: When keccak FSM state (u_keccak.keccak_st) is in {KeccakStActive, KeccakStPhase1, KeccakStPhase2Cycle1, KeccakStPhase2Cycle2, KeccakStPhase2Cycle3}, signals run_req_o and run_ack_i are both high in that same cycle.
guarantees.cond: u_keccak.keccak_st inside {KeccakStActive, KeccakStPhase1, KeccakStPhase2Cycle1, KeccakStPhase2Cycle2, KeccakStPhase2Cycle3}

guarantees.claim: Signal mux_sel never takes any value other than MuxGuard or MuxRelease.
The main FSM state st is always one of the sparse-encoded values: StIdle_sparse, StAbsorb_sparse, StSqueeze_sparse, StManualRun_sparse, StFlush_sparse, StTerminalError_sparse.

When state_valid_o is deasserted, all bits of the state data are forced to zero. In masked mode (EnMasking), state_o[0] and state_o[1] both become zero; in unmasked mode, only state_o[0] becomes zero.

When error_o.valid is asserted, the set of internal control signals {start_i, process_i, run_i, done_i} does not equal the set of forwarded Keccak control signals {keccak_start, keccak_process, sw_keccak_run, keccak_done} in that same cycle.

assumptions.claim: The input run_i may be asserted only while either error_o.valid is true or the current state is StSqueeze_sparse.
assumptions.risk: If run_i is asserted outside the Squeeze state without an active error, the design may enter an illegal control state, leading to corrupted processing or dropped data.

uncertain_points.claim: A partially commented assertion `StateValidPeriod_A` suggests the designer intended to specify the exact timing window during which state_valid_o is asserted, but the property body was never completed.
uncertain_points.risk: Missing temporal constraint on state_valid_o could allow stale data to be read as valid, or cause misalignment with handshake protocols.

uncertain_points.claim: KeccakIdleWhenNoRunHs_A expects run_ack_i to be high in exactly the same cycle that keccak_st is active (immediate conjunction). If run_ack_i is not a purely combinational/registered output of the Keccak instance but a delayed response, this assertion will fire falsely and hide real handshake violations.
uncertain_points.risk: False assertion failure reporting may mask genuine protocol errors, or the design may inadvertently rely on an unrealistically prompt handshake, leading to system-level deadlock or inconsistency.
